activity.notes: Margaret became the dominant ruler of Sweden after defeating and capturing Albert of Mecklenburg in 1389 and was formally installed as Swedish regent that year. ATLAS records the Swedish pre-Kalmar phase through 1397, when the existing Kalmar Union Activity begins.

sources.title: Margrete 1. — Lex
sources.citation_text: Lex states that Margaret exercised governing power in Sweden from 1389 to 1412 and was formally installed as Swedish regent in October 1389.
